name: Gisele
source: Gisele is a student at Lind Academy who often fades into the background. Quiet and insecure, she struggles to connect with others and tends to follow rather than lead. Close with the more outgoing Becky, she has felt increasingly left out since Becky found a boyfriend, often trailing behind as an awkward third wheel. Overlooked and forgotten, Gisele is a person few would notice if she disappeared into the dark undercurrents of Lind.
